Hi Saurabh / Emily —

Adding a few technical notes to answer your questions: 

1) KMS/HSM: For Dedicated capacity we support customer-managed keys via standard KMS integrations (AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault). Keys are held in the customer account and we support envelope encryption so private keys never transit Redwood-managed key stores. For Private on-prem deployments we can integrate with on-prem HSMs (PKCS#11) — that path requires an initial engineering integration window (typically 4–6 weeks for HSM validation).

2) Control mapping: we’ll provide a control mapping spreadsheet that maps Redwood controls to SOC 2 principles and common HITRUST/HIPAA control objectives. I’ve attached a short sample mapping in the Drive link; full spreadsheet will arrive by Friday.

3) Lead times (high-level):
- Dedicated capacity: procurement -> capacity provisioning -> validation: ~4–8 weeks depending on region and instance type.
- Private VPC (cloud-hosted, customer VPC peering): ~6–10 weeks including networking and peering setup.
- On-prem / air-gapped: depends on hardware but typically 8–16 weeks (includes on-prem agent install / HSM integration).

4) Evidence: we can provide the SOC2 Type II report (redacted), system descriptions, control mappings, and screenshots of audit logs for scoped subsystems. For final auditor review they sometimes request additional artifacts; we’ll coordinate to gather those if needed.

I’ll block 60 minutes next Wednesday 1–2pm PT for a technical deep-dive unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks — Neha
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
